title: Damaged packaging complaints concentrate on courier MetroDash
businessImpact: 65 complaints affected, £8,177 of order value exposed, 62 customers involved. Risk score 81.9/100 driven by statistics (100% of that factor) and volume (100% of that factor).
summary: 65 of 86 damaged packaging complaints (75.6%) come from courier MetroDash, which handles 27.0% of orders — a 2.8x lift.

aiHypotheses.statement: A handling or transit problem specific to courier MetroDash may be driving the concentration 75.6% of these complaints versus 27.0% of orders.
aiHypotheses.reasoning: Would be confirmed by a site or route audit of courier MetroDash and by complaint notes mentioning handling damage. Would be rejected if the same product complains equally through other couriers or hubs.

aiHypotheses.statement: Part of the pattern may be a labelling or assignment shift rather than a real change in operations.
aiHypotheses.reasoning: Would be confirmed by comparing category labels and order-to-courier assignment rules with the period before the lift appeared. Would be rejected if labels and routing rules are unchanged.
